payload.name: Signature 100x50 Under 10KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 100 x 50 signature workflow for strict 10KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 100 x 50 signature under 10KB workflow for forms that require a small signature image plus an extremely tight KB cap. It points to local resize and compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
